question.text:

\hline & \text{List - I} & & \text{List - II} \\
& \text{(Compound)} & & \text{(Uses)} \\
\hline \text { A. } & \text { Iodoform } & \text { I. } & \text { Fire extinguisher } \\
\hline \text { B. } & \text { Carbon tetrachloride } & \text { II. } & \text { Insecticide } \\
\hline \text { C. } & \text { CFC } & \text { III. } & \text { Antiseptic } \\
\hline \text { D. } & \text { DDT } & \text { IV. } & \text { Refrigerants } \\
\hline
\end{array}\)
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

solution.text:

$\mathrm{CCl}_4$ - Fire extinguishe
